item.title: DOTr grounds entire Aleson Shipping fleet after Basilan ferry sinking
item.description: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) announced that it has grounded the entire fleet of Aleson Shipping Lines following the sinking of its M/V Trisha Kerstin 3 roll-on/roll-off (RORO) ferry in Basilan waters. “Today, we are announcing the grounding of Aleson Shipping Lines’ entire passenger fleet,” DOTr Acting Secretary Giovanni Lopez said during a press briefing. …
